title: Slayer's Sweet, Tangy, and Spicy Kabobs
description: This Slayer's sweet, tangy, and spicy kababs recipe includes maraschino cherry and pineapple chunks to finish off these tasty, spicy chicken skewers.
ingredients: 0.25 cup hot pepper sauce (such as Crystal®)
4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch pieces
1 (8 ounce) package fresh mushrooms, stems removed
1 small red onion, cut into chunks
1 red bell pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps.text: Whisk soy sauce, pineapple juice, wine, hot pepper sauce, maraschino cherry juice, brown sugar, honey, lime juice, lemon juice, garlic powder, ginger, black pepper, and cayenne pepper together in a large bowl. Add chicken, mushrooms, onion, bell pepper, and tomatoes; toss until evenly coated in marinade. Cover the bowl; marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Thread 1 chicken piece, 3 vegetable pieces (mixing and matching as you assemble), 1 more chicken piece, 1 pineapple chunk, then 1 maraschino cherry onto each skewer.
Cook on the preheated grill until chicken is no longer pink in centers and vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
